A '''female [[Kitonak/Legends|Kitonak]]''' was trained as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[New Jedi Order]]. During the [[Swarm War]] this individual was training to become a Jedi at the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Ossus Academy]]. When [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]] visited the academy, the apprentice [[Force jump/Legends|leapt]] over the Aristocra in order to demonstrate her [[The Force/Legends|Force]] abilities.<ref name="J" />
